text:
Both pages fail 2.1.1 Keyboard and 2.4.7 Focus Visible. I could not settle several other criteria, so they are NEEDS_REVIEW. The results come from an agent-assisted run of the Trusted Tester tests. They are not a certified result.

**Home page**
- **2.1.1 Keyboard: FAIL.** The "Search Stories" item in the header works with a mouse but keyboard focus never reaches it, and nothing else on the page leads to Search Stories.
- **2.4.7 Focus Visible: FAIL.** The "SDE" button in the header shows no change when it has keyboard focus. The "Help and Support" button needs a person to check, because the screenshots did not show its focus style clearly.
- **1.3.1, 4.1.2 (field labels) and 2.4.6 (label descriptiveness): NEEDS_REVIEW.** The search text box is named only by its placeholder "Type to search...". A person should check this with a screen reader.
- **2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap: NEEDS_REVIEW.** The tool could not finish tabbing through the page after pressing Search, and the page loads more content as you scroll.
- **3.2.1 On Focus and 3.2.2 On Input: NEEDS_REVIEW.** The "All" dropdown's options were not checked, because Tab does not go into them after the menu opens.
- **2.4.3 Focus Order: NEEDS_REVIEW.** After the "All" dropdown opens, the next Tab skips its options and goes to the search box. I could not tell whether that matters.
- **3.3.1 Error Identification, 3.3.3 Error Suggestion and 3.3.4 Error Prevention: DNA.** The only form is a site search. It accepted an empty value and "abc" without showing an error, and it is not a legal, financial or data submission.
- **3.3.2 Labels or Instructions:** The tool reports that each field has a visible label or instructions. The text box has only placeholder text, which is the same issue as the NEEDS_REVIEW above. I am reporting the tool's PASS but you may want to check it.
- **1.4.2 Audio Control, 2.2.2 Pause, Stop, Hide and 2.3.1 Three Flashes: DNA.** Nothing played audio, moved, blinked or flashed.

**My Search Stories page**
- **2.1.1 Keyboard: FAIL.** The logo area at the top left and the breadcrumb "Home" link both work with a mouse. Keyboard focus never reaches either, and no reached element goes home.
- **2.4.7 Focus Visible: FAIL.** The "SDE" button shows no change when it has keyboard focus. "Help and Support" needs a person to check.
- **2.4.3 Focus Order: NEEDS_REVIEW.** Focus jumps from "Help and Support" back to the whole-page slide container, and several controls after it have no visible box.
- **2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap, 3.2.1 On Focus and 1.3.1/4.1.2: PASS.** There was no trap, no element changed context when focused, and the buttons "SDE" and "SEARCH" have adequate accessible names.
- **2.2.2, 1.4.2 and 2.3.1: DNA.** Nothing moved, blinked, flashed or played audio.
- **3.2.2, 3.3.1, 3.3.2, 3.3.3, 3.3.4 and 2.4.6 (field labels): DNA.** The tool found no form fields to label or submit.

**Both pages**
- **2.4.1, 2.4.5, 3.2.3 and 3.2.4: NEEDS_REVIEW.** The tool judged each page identical to the other, so it could not compare them. This may be because the site is a single-page application. A person should compare the pages by hand.
